'''Chocolate cows''' could be found instead of regular [[cow]]s in all areas (except Zanaris) as a [[teaser]] for the [[player-owned farm]] a week prior to its release.

==Locations==
* [[Lumbridge]] farm
* North of the windmill north-west of [[Lumbridge]] (around [[Beefy Bill]])
* [[Yanille]]
* [[Sinclair Mansion]]
* Around the west and south sides of the [[Crafting Guild]]
* South of [[Falador]], north-west of the cabbage patch
* West of [[Legends' Guild]], north of Ardougne
* [[Taverley]] cow pens
** West of the [[Stone Circle]]
** West of the [[Pet Shop]]
